result.topic_en: Draft passage on integrals that are independent of the path in a surface T, introducing the distinction between simply and multiply connected surfaces and their conversion by cuts, before a theorem on curve systems a and b (cf. the analysis situs section of Riemann's 1857 paper on Abelian functions).
